bullets: • SBI ELSS Tax Advantage Fund carries an exit load of 0%, meaning no exit load fee is charged upon redemption after the mandatory 3-year lock-in period is completed.
• The 3-year lock-in period for SBI ELSS Tax Advantage Fund means investors cannot redeem units before this period, effectively making the exit load structure irrelevant until lock-in ends.
• SBI Large Cap Fund Direct Plan has an expense ratio typically ranging from 0.5–0.9% per annum, which is deducted from the fund's Net Asset Value (NAV) on an ongoing basis.
• Regular plans of SBI Mutual Fund schemes carry a higher expense ratio compared to direct plans, as they include distributor commission costs passed on to the investor.
• Securities Transaction Tax (STT) of 0.001% is applicable on equity mutual fund redemptions, which is a government-mandated tax separate from the fund's exit load structure.
• SEBI mandates that all mutual fund schemes disclose their Total Expense Ratio (TER), ensuring transparency for investors reviewing cost structures across SBI Mutual Fund schemes.
